messages:
maya: Quick QA: Retention modal slider is skipped when tabbing. Screen reader says 'Range' but no value.
sam: Repro. Custom thumb lacks role=slider and aria-valuenow. tabindex missing.
andre: Also focus ring invisible on dark theme. Contrast fails.
olivia: Copy tweak: change 'Data retention' -> 'Retention period'. Tooltip: 'Automatically delete user and system data after the selected time.'
ben: Export CSV header mismatch: 'event_time' vs UI 'Time (UTC)'. Analytics expects 'timestamp' ISO8601. Can we standardize?
maya: Yes, use 'timestamp' and add export version.
sam: Plan: add role="slider", aria-valuemin/max/now/text, tabindex=0, keyboard handlers (arrows, pgup/pgdn). Add axe checks.
andre: Use existing --focus-ring token, ensure 2px high-contrast outline for keyboard focus only.
olivia: I'll provide short/long copy for i18n and a KMS label change: 'Customer-managed encryption (BYOK)' with hint 'Key region must match data region.'
ben: Filing infra ticket #UI-10021 for CSV rename and migration notes.
prodbot: Staging deploy (slider a11y fixes) scheduled 2025-01-10T14:00:00Z.
maya: Acceptance criteria: 1) Slider keyboard operable; 2) SR reads human-friendly value; 3) Visible focus ring; 4) Modal copy updated + i18n; 5) KMS label clarified; 6) CSV header standardized to 'timestamp' with migration. I'll collate PR checklist. :thumbsup:
